definitions.gloss: Vernal Equinox Day; Spring Equinox Day
definitions.explanation: A Japanese national holiday that falls around March 20-21, on the date of the vernal equinox. It is a day for appreciating nature and showing love for living things. Also traditionally a day for visiting family graves.

examples.japanese: {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}→国民の祝日：22469_kokuminnoshukujitsu⟧です。
examples.english: Vernal Equinox Day is a national holiday.

examples.japanese: {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We went to visit the family graves on Vernal Equinox Day.

examples.japanese: {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After Vernal Equinox Day, the daytime becomes longer than the nighttime.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
One of Japan's national holidays, established to celebrate the arrival of spring. The exact date varies slightly each year based on the astronomical equinox, typically falling on March 20 or 21. The holiday is part of a week-long Buddhist observance called ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ (higan), during which Japanese families visit ancestral graves and make offerings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧ (around Vernal Equinox Day)
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ (spring equinox week)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Autumnal Equinox Day — the autumn counterpart, falling around September 22-23
